onboarding.slide1Title: Turn any photo into a sticker
onboarding.slide1Body: Pick a photo of yourself, a friend or your pet and let AI do the drawing.
onboarding.slide2Title: Choose a mood, add a caption
onboarding.slide2Body: Dozens of ready-made ideas, or describe your own in a single line.
onboarding.slide3Body: Export packs straight to WhatsApp and Telegram, or save them to Photos.

auth.title: Save your stickers
auth.subtitle: Sign in to keep your stickers and get extra free credits.
auth.legalNote: By continuing you accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
auth.bonusNote: New accounts get {{generations}} extra generations and {{exports}} extra exports.
auth.failed: Sign in did not work. Please try again.
auth.conflictBody: You already signed in with this Apple ID or Google account before. We can open that account, but the stickers you made as a guest stay on this device only.

home.title: Create
home.backgroundHint: We will send you a notification when the sticker is ready.
home.ideaRequired: Pick an idea or describe one
home.limitedAccessBody: You shared only a few photos. You can add more at any time.

crop.title: Crop
crop.hint: Keep the face inside the square.

generation.retryFree: Retrying is free — your credit was returned.
generation.transparencyHint: The checkerboard shows the transparent areas.

library.title: My stickers
library.emptyBody: Your stickers will show up here as soon as you create the first one.
library.confirmDeleteBody_one: This removes {{count}} sticker from your library and from every pack.
library.confirmDeleteBody_other: This removes {{count}} stickers from your library and from every pack.

packs.title: Packs
packs.emptyBody: A pack is what WhatsApp installs. Put 3 to 30 stickers in one and export it.
packs.confirmDeleteBody: The stickers stay in your library.

export.title: Export
export.appNotInstalled: {{app}} is not installed on this iPhone.
export.telegramFallback: Telegram could not import the pack, so we opened the share sheet instead.

issues.too_few_stickers_one: Add {{missing}} more sticker to export to WhatsApp.
issues.too_few_stickers_other: Add {{missing}} more stickers to export to WhatsApp.
issues.too_many_stickers: WhatsApp accepts at most {{max}} stickers per pack.
issues.missing_tray_icon: Pick a tray icon for this pack.
issues.missing_webp: {{count}} sticker is still being prepared. Try again in a moment.
issues.name_too_long: Pack names can be at most {{max}} characters.

export.needsPack: Put these stickers in a pack first, then send the whole pack.
export.singleStickerOnly: The share sheet takes one sticker at a time.

paywall.title: Get more credits
paywall.subtitleGuest: Sign in for free credits, or buy a pack of credits right away.
paywall.subtitleOutOfGenerations: You have used all your generations.
paywall.subtitleOutOfExports: You have used all your exports.
paywall.subtitleFirstExport: Your first export is on us.
paywall.failed: The purchase did not go through.
paywall.unavailable: The store is not reachable right now. Please try again later.
paywall.subscriptionNote: {{price}} per {{period}}, renews automatically until cancelled. Cancel any time in the App Store.

settings.title: Settings
settings.guestAccount: You are using a guest account
settings.guestAccountBody: Sign in to keep your stickers if you change phones.
settings.analyticsBody: Helps us find crashes and broken flows. Never includes your photos.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.body: This permanently deletes your stickers, packs, credits and account. It cannot be undone and purchased credits are not refunded.
deleteAccount.failed: We could not delete the account. Please contact support.

support.title: Contact support
support.subject: Subject
support.diagnosticsNote: We attach your app version and the last error code. No photos are sent.
support.sentBody: We usually answer within a couple of days.
support.failed: The message could not be sent.

moderation.disclaimerBody: Stickers are generated by AI and can look different from the photo. Only upload photos you have the right to use, and do not upload photos of other people without their permission.
moderation.blockedBody: This photo or idea does not fit our content rules. Try another photo or a different idea — no credits were used.
moderation.reportSent: Thanks. We will look into it.

notifications.askTitle: Get a ping when it is ready
notifications.askBody: Generation takes up to a minute. We can notify you instead of making you wait here.

errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
errors.moderation_blocked: This photo or idea does not fit our content rules.
errors.provider_timeout: The sticker took too long to generate. Your credit was returned.
errors.provider_error: The generator had a problem. Your credit was returned.
errors.invalid_image: That image could not be read. Try another photo.
errors.native_module_unavailable: This export needs the full app build.
errors.photo_permission: Sticker Studio needs access to your photos.
errors.camera_permission: Sticker Studio needs access to the camera.
errors.upload_failed: The photo could not be uploaded.
errors.app_not_installed: That app is not installed on this iPhone.
